scope: Fresh default-placement parallel builtin delegate children with append-mode prompts; not retained-worker continuation or full provider parity
cause: The child safety boundary uses a whole-prompt before_agent_start return. Pi makes the effective provider prompt opaque through forceSystemPrompt, so the adapter could not account for the generated documentation section despite the complete canonical base remaining unchanged.
fix: Supply the structured canonical Pi system message and project only an exact full-base prefix, retaining its entire suffix. Unknown rewrites and explicit documentation remain protected.

red.error: Cannot project an inherited Pi base prompt safely. Required instructions were not removed. Use a portable prompt for this SDK call.

retainedDiagnostics.classification: Different launch mode, not the original bug
retainedDiagnostics.finding: Explicit foreground delegates use borrowed hookless bridges and reached the upstream request restriction. No billing, authentication or model fallback was applied.
A custom system prompt intentionally omits generated Pi rule/tool-guide sections; requiring those absent sections was incorrect. Custom/operator content remains required.

retainedDiagnostics.classification: Prompt fix passed on Codex and SDK Opus; Haiku Git fixture failed
retainedDiagnostics.finding: Both Haiku delegates passed the prompt guard and ran tools. The Git child added a path filter, which hides empty commits. The final fixture uses real file-changing commits instead; the earlier failure remains recorded.

live.sourceVerification: The checked and replay-tested index.ts and bridge.ts were copied into the clean installed checkout for the normal-resource run, compared before launch, then restored with a compare-before-restore EXIT trap. No hook-only provider override was used.

limits: Hookless foreground append-mode prompt projection is not implemented by this change
Durable foreground-to-background retained-worker continuation remains SDK-3
General instruction, environment, output-limit and unknown-history changes remain guarded
No full parity matrix, full local suite, physical Safari, overnight stress or child-local history-lifecycle verification
